conbody.p: During the process of negotiation, you may find a section of text that you would like to mark as smart. Mark document content as a clause when:

ul.li: You are with a third party offline agreement created or imported into the agreement record that contains language which should be tagged as clauses.
An external party adds language to the agreement document that constitutes a clause.
